assumptions.statement: The repository provisional rough polygons are used only to generate a coherent temporary model.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive geometry and metrics require full recalculation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official cleared SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons become available.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, heritage controls, and municipal capacities remain pending official data.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level demolition, building scale, road engineering, or approval claim is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory and specialist-control material becomes available.

assumptions.statement: Second Encounter spaces are lightweight, staffed, reversible civic interfaces rather than a new statutory institution.
assumptions.impact: Governance roles, staffing, privacy design, and service-level agreements require local professional and community co-design.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A named public owner, operator, frontline staff group, and pilot community are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: The 3/14/30-day response rhythm and proposed staffed sessions are pilot service targets, not confirmed government commitments.
assumptions.impact: They make responsibility testable while remaining adjustable to staff capacity, service risk, and community co-design.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A named operator, staffing plan, service-specific risk assessment, and pilot agreement are approved.

assumptions.statement: Return evidence uses opt-in, purpose-limited, de-identified records and accepts paper or in-person testimony; identity tracking is not a design dependency.
assumptions.impact: No sensor coverage or personal-history database is proposed as a prerequisite.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A lawful service-specific data protection assessment is completed.

assumptions.statement: Railway heritage is treated as a narrative and public-space memory spine; exact protection boundaries and interventions are not inferred.
assumptions.impact: All structures near heritage assets remain lightweight conceptual suggestions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official heritage protection and construction-control boundaries are supplied.

assumptions.statement: No host building, land owner, operating organisation, insurer, or named public accountable owner has accepted the proposal.
assumptions.impact: The six stations, three landmarks, opening hours, and RACI are design specifications rather than authorised commitments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Written host-space, owner, operator, insurance, and accountability agreements are completed.

assumptions.statement: PUBLIC_SPACE features are nine conceptual node surfaces, not proof of public ownership, acquisition, service catchments, or completed public realm.
assumptions.impact: Public-space area and ratio describe only this provisional design model and must not be used as planning-control indicators.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official cadastral, public-realm, ownership, and survey data are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Staff pay, roster capacity, training, maintenance, insurance, rent, fit-out, fire review, accessibility audit, and data-protection review have not been priced or procured.
assumptions.impact: The proposal uses qualitative resource bands and a two-station pilot; it does not publish a false precise budget.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Named hosts and operators provide local rates, staffing model, and compliance requirements.

assumptions.statement: The query-code concept is pending threat modelling, accessibility review, retention policy, deletion route, lost-code process, and human-service equivalence.
assumptions.impact: No device fingerprinting, IP tracking, identity graph, or public case detail is authorised by this proposal.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Independent privacy, security, accessibility, and frontline review approves a bounded pilot design.

assumptions.statement: The six personas and the older-resident journey are composite design lenses written by the proposal team, not interviews or evidence of community consent.
assumptions.impact: They may structure recruitment and testing but cannot be quoted as residents' views.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Documented, consented engagement with affected residents and frontline staff is completed.

assumptions.statement: T0/T1/T2/T3 response windows are risk-tiered pilot service targets, not statutory deadlines or service guarantees.
assumptions.impact: Each service owner must accept, reject, or adapt the target against actual jurisdiction and staff capacity before launch.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Service-specific operating agreement and pilot roster are signed.
